---
title: "R CMD check"
description: "Runs R CMD check across a matrix of OSes and R versions, with optional Codecov upload."
---

`R-CMD-Check.yml` installs your package's dependencies, runs
`R CMD check` for every combination of runner OS and R version, and
uploads test coverage to [Codecov](https://codecov.io) from the first
combination only.

## Example

{{< example r-cmd-check.yml >}}

Extra system libraries go into `extra-apt-packages`; extra R packages that
aren't in your `DESCRIPTION` (e.g. for tests) go into `extra-r-packages`,
as plain names — the workflow adds the `any::` prefix itself.

::: {.callout-tip}
Use this workflow as a required status check on `dev`, and again inside the
[release chain](release.qmd), where a passing check on the `dev` → `main`
PR is what allows the automatic merge.
:::
